rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the literal universe-related sense, especially before another noun.

example.english: This telescope can observe galaxies in the cosmic depths of the universe.
example.traditional: 呢部望遠鏡可以觀察到宇宙深處嘅星系。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 mong6 jyun5 geng3 ho2 ji5 gun1 caat3 dou3 jyu5 zau6 sam1 cyu3 ge3 sing1 hai6

rows.note: Use this when cosmic emphasizes enormous size or scale without referring literally to the universe.

example.english: The computer really cannot handle such a cosmic amount of data.
example.traditional: 要處理咁龐大嘅數據量，部電腦真係頂唔順。
example.jyutping: jiu3 cyu2 lei5 gam3 pong4 daai6 ge3 sou3 geoi3 loeng6 bou6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6

rows.note: Use this for an exceptionally large or extreme scale, often with a dramatic or humorous tone.

example.english: The goal he scored in the final was absolutely cosmic!
example.traditional: 佢喺決賽射入嗰球，真係宇宙級精彩！
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 kyut3 coi3 se6 jap6 go2 kau4 zan1 hai6 jyu5 zau6 kap1 zing1 coi2
